svg.text: What do everyday experiences reveal about
Research and presentation: Jamie Ko / Visual support: Bob / Field photographs supplied by Bob and Jamie
A Hong Kong-centred inquiry, returning to Singapore–Johor with questions. Pictured people are not identified as participants.
